libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: No Docker service appears necessary for the existing Hibernate coverage pattern; the tests can continue using an in-memory H2 JDBC URL, including H2 compatibility modes for dialect smoke tests.

deterministic_setup.reason: Provides oracle.jdbc.OracleConnection required by Hibernate 6.1 OracleArrayJdbcType during OracleDialect initialization.

input_evidence.name: issue
input_evidence.summary: #818 [Automation] java run fails for org.hibernate:hibernate-core:6.1.0.Final; label=fails-java-run; body_chars=8015

risks: If the generated tests exercise real Oracle-specific JDBC behavior beyond dialect initialization, ojdbc11 alone may not be enough without an Oracle-compatible database service.
Oracle JDBC classes may introduce additional reachability metadata needs during native-image verification.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: Hibernate 6.1 initializes OracleArrayJdbcType when OracleDialect is resolved, and that class reflectively requires oracle.jdbc.OracleConnection, which is not provided by hibernate-core or the existing test dependencies.
